fields.description: The sender this rule is for: either an email address (john@example.com) or a domain prefixed with @ (@example.com), which covers every sender from that domain and its subdomains.
fields.label: Email or Domain

fields.description: The category mail from this sender is given when it is first fetched. Mail that already has a category is not changed.
fields.label: Category

fields.description: The JMAP account this rule belongs to. It applies to everyone with access to the account, and wins over a site-wide rule for the same sender. Leave empty to make the rule site-wide: it applies to every account. Only a System Manager or Suite Admin can manage site-wide rules.
fields.label: Account

fields.description: A disabled rule is ignored. Disable a default rule instead of deleting it: a deleted one comes back with the next update.
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: Shipped with the app and kept in step with it on every update. A default rule cannot be edited, only disabled; a site-wide or account rule for the same sender wins over it.
fields.label: Default Rule
